processing_operations: Validated Moon south-polar stereographic CRS and metre units
Preserved native 20 m/pixel raster geometry and values
Preserved the source nodata mask; no missing observations were filled
warnings: The effective-resolution ancillary is an overview average over the same window, not a 20 m effective-resolution claim
The product is a 40.96 km pole-centered subset, not the complete 80S-90S parent DEM
No Earth-to-Moon coordinate transform was applied
known_limitations: This is a pole-centered 40.96 km subset, not the complete 80S-90S parent DEM.
The subset is native-coordinate bounded; no Earth-to-Moon coordinate transform was applied.
The source product documents interpolation and adjusted/blended construction; effective resolution must be respected.

provenance.citation: Barker et al., 2023, Planetary Science Journal, 4, 183
